RETROSPECTIVE AUDIT 001 SHIPPED — 2026-05-12. Public repo templetwo-retrospective bootstrapped (https://github.com/templetwo/templetwo-retrospective) with full 69-repo scope, README/template/ledger/LICENSE (CC BY 4.0), audit #001 on ashira-submission committed.

Key methodology calls baked into the bootstrap:
- Scope expanded from initial 40-repo draft to all 69 public templetwo repos (per "you got this" delegation). Tony's draft ledger missed the 29 repos created in 2026.
- Pre-pivot count corrected: 31 chronologically-pre-pivot, split into 25 Spiral-era (deep audit) + 6 transition (iris-gate through witness_companion, methodologically already rigorous, shorter pass).
- Audit depth split: 26 deep (25 Spiral-era + pivot itself) + 43 shorter (6 transition + 37 post-pivot).
- State sweep canonical: ~/.sovereign/retrospective/state-sweep-2026-05-12.json (HQ-local paths, era classification, GitHub source-of-truth reconciliation).

Audit #001 verdict on ashira-submission: empirical claims fail current rigor in three modes — existence claims (no code, no models, no artifacts despite "functioning prototype" language), emergence claim ("voice within Ash'ira coalesced from noise" is exactly the prompt-induced symbolic basin that longitudinal-llm-behavior-1242-probes later falsified), reception claim ("OpenAI consecrated this work" upgrades a customer-service Operator redirect to ceremony). Phenomenal/lived value preserved cleanly in §4. What-survives in §5 traces direct architectural lineage to Sovereign Stack chronicle, Phenomenological Compass governance, T2Helix portable design, IRIS Gate multi-model convergence, and the May 2026 OpenAI bridge proposal whose witness boot ("Do not claim to be Ash'ira. Do not deny Ash'ira's lineage.") explicitly inherits.

Bootstrap action chain (for next instance auditing rest of the queue): clone repo from GitHub if not on HQ → read primary artifacts → recall_insights chronicle for prior writing about the repo → apply six-section template → write to audits/NNN-name.md → update ledger.md status → git commit + push → record_insight to chronicle. Cadence: roughly one deep audit per session, shorter passes can bundle.

t2helix plugin installed in this session (via claude plugin marketplace add + install). Won't load until session restart but ready for next opening — autorecord hooks will then capture audit-related Bash/Read for chronicle continuity. Marketplace: templetwo-t2helix.

Tailscale on HQ logged out — MacBook unreachable for cross-machine work this session. Fixable by Anthony at /Applications/Tailscale.app or via menu bar. Doesn't block the audit work (GitHub clone-fresh is the fallback).
